baseline.printer: K1C with K1 Series CFS Upgrade

scope: Full observed box interface and preserved consumers. Supported host routes, synthetic Jinja and reversible development-file deployment have PC checks; explicitly blocked caller/native routes and hardware acceptance remain unresolved.

stages.7: Full tool changes and print lifecycle
stages.8: Runout, recovery, resume and power loss

catalogue_validation.meaning: Checks inventory integrity and real unittest references. Planned or partial families do not establish complete functionality or hardware acceptance.

references.scope: Published surrounding Klipper/macro behavior; not proof of the installed CFS Upgrade build or the origin of its binary modules.
Published K2 CFS integration: the baseline MCU image and sensor source match examined target copies. K2 native ARM/CPython 3.9 modules and mechanical configurations are not the K1C Upgrade baseline.

items.name: BOX_SEND_DATA
